candidates.spoken: The Titanic sank on her maiden voyage.
How can a ship meet the rules and still fail?
After Titanic, SOLAS rules made lifeboats for everyone aboard mandatory.
They weren't high enough to stop it.
Titanic's bulkheads were not open-topped by accident.
It went down in two hours and forty minutes.
It was built to stay afloat with four compartments flooded.
There weren't enough lifeboats for everyone.
Now international rules require lifeboats for everyone aboard.
It took only an iceberg scraping along the starboard side.
The iceberg opened more than that along the side.
It started with iceberg seen too late. It ended with ship sinks.

script.spoken: The Titanic sank on her maiden voyage. It went down in two hours and forty minutes, and more than fifteen hundred people died. It was built to stay afloat with four compartments flooded. The iceberg opened more than that along the side. As the bow sank lower, water spilled over the watertight walls. They weren't high enough to stop it. There weren't enough lifeboats for everyone. Now international rules require lifeboats for everyone aboard.
